seller.title: AI Seller
seller.subtitle: Turn a product review video into ready-to-post sales posts with images, product link and a pinned comment. AI writes relaxed captions for TikTok, Shopee, Facebook and Instagram.

steps.productDesc: Choose what you sell, then add the photos or video you filmed
steps.videoDesc: Upload your own clip, or let AI make one from the Skills Library
steps.detailsDesc: Price, selling points and the affiliate link can wait
steps.copyDesc: AI writes captions, hashtags and a comment with your link

list.emptyDesc: Start by choosing a product and adding the photos or clip you filmed. The affiliate link can wait.

create.title: New sales post
create.desc: Choose what you sell and add the photos or clip you filmed. The affiliate link and other details can wait.
create.media: Product photos or a video you filmed
create.mediaHint: Upload them first. Details such as the affiliate link go on the next page.
create.urlHint: Skip this if you want. A shop link can pull the name, images and price.
create.fromStudio: Or pick a finished video from the Skills Library
create.fromStudioHint: Uses the product details and images from that project.
create.needProduct: Add a product name, or upload a photo or video
create.ingestFailed: Could not read that link. Fill in the details on the next page.
create.withSkill: Selected skill: {skill}. Add the product and we take you to the video step.

delete.title: Delete sales post
delete.message: Delete "{title}"? Videos and images are kept.

product.name: Product name
product.nameHint: You can leave this for later. AI needs a name before it writes captions.
product.affiliateHint: When set, the comment uses this link instead of the product link.
product.detailsPlaceholder: e.g. absorbs fast, not sticky, light scent, daily use
product.detailsHint: AI only uses what you write here and never invents claims.

video.studioEmpty: No finished (merged) videos in the Skills Library yet.

copy.notesPlaceholder: e.g. 50% off until month end, free shipping
copy.failed: The last attempt failed. Try again.

ready.title: Ready to post
ready.empty: Pick channels and press "Write captions with AI". Copy-ready text appears here.
ready.caption: Caption
ready.noLink: No link yet. Add a product or affiliate link in Details to include it in the comment.
ready.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
ready.autoDesc: Connect Facebook / Instagram / TikTok accounts and schedule posts. For now, copy the text and download the files to post.

tips.tiktok: TikTok: upload the video, paste the caption, then post the comment + link (or pin the cart if you use TikTok Shop).
tips.shopee: Shopee: post through Shopee Video in the app and tag the product from your shop.
tips.facebook: Facebook: post as a Reel or Page video, then comment the link and pin it.
tips.instagram: Instagram: links in captions are not clickable, so put the link in a comment or your bio.

skillVideo.title: Skills Library: pick a video style
skillVideo.divider: Or let AI make a new video with the Skills Library
skillVideo.runningHint: This takes a few minutes. You can close this page; the video is attached to the post when it is done.
skillVideo.selectedHint: About {n} seconds · uses the name, photos, price and details you already added
skillVideo.noPresenter: No avatar or influencer with an image yet.
skillVideo.createPresenter: Create one in the Skills Library
skillVideo.make: Make the video with this skill
skillVideo.costHint: Uses your configured image and video models (provider charges apply).
skillVideo.attached: Video is ready and attached to the post

home.subtitle: Choose what you sell, add the photos or clip you filmed, then fill in details like an affiliate link. AI helps with the video and captions.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search skills or posts, e.g. review, unboxing…
home.skillsTitle: Pick a skill to start selling
home.skillsDesc: Each skill is a sales-video format. Pick one, add your product, and AI makes the video and captions.
